primitives.name: Chronological Fact Control Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: The purpose is to give counsel a readable, chronological account of what happened, who was involved, which facts are documented, which facts are Garrett Baxley's personal account, and which records are likely employer-held or need discovery.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t': 'time in days since onboarding', 'F_d': 'documented facts in primary artifacts', 'F_c': 'corroborated facts via metadata/third-party', 'F_g': "Garrett's current account", 'F_eh': 'employer-held records requiring discovery'}
primitives.assumptions: All facts are categorized into one of four classes: [D], [C], [GA], [EH].
primitives.breakdown_regime: When [F_d] ∩ [F_eh] ≠ ∅, a conflict arises between documented and employer-held records.

layer2.mapping: Each fact category maps to a conditional probability P(fact|source_type), enabling Bayesian updating.
layer2.telemetry: Source-strength label consistency across narrative anchors.

primitives.name: Disability Disclosure Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: Garrett sent Corina the Owner's Manual, which disclosed that he is on the autism spectrum and explained
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D_s': 'disability status disclosed', 'T_h': 'HR communication channel', 'T_c': 'corroborating communication trace', 'A_d': 'awareness of disability-related distress'}
primitives.assumptions: Disclosure occurs through employer-invited HR channels and is subject to internal tracking.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If A_d = 0, then the employer failed to act on known disability-related distress.

layer2.mapping: Protocol defines a kernel for evaluating employer responsiveness to disability disclosures.
layer2.telemetry: Presence of [CN] or [D] entries indicating disclosure and follow-up.

primitives.name: Escalation Signal Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: [D] The third anchor is the February 23, 2026 Jeff Dolan welfare/support text.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_e': 'escalation signal strength', 'T_w': 'welfare/textual support trigger', 'T_d': 'distress indicator', 'R_a': 'response action taken'}
primitives.assumptions: Supportive messaging indicates awareness of distress and potential intervention.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If T_w > threshold and R_a = 0, then employer response failure is indicated.

layer2.mapping: Signal strength maps to a temporal decay function of distress and employer engagement.
layer2.telemetry: Temporal proximity of [CN] and [D] entries to termination event.
